title: Triviality of the restricted character
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $H$ be a linear subspace of $\mathbb{F}_2^n$, and let $x\in\mathbb{F}_2^n$. The character on $H$ given by evaluating each vector's Walsh character at $x$ is trivial if and only if $x$ is orthogonal to $H$ under the standard dot product over $\mathbb{F}_2$.
